ap_physics_1-m02.set_intro: On a frictionless track, a $2\text{ kg}$ cart moving at $5\text{ m/s}$ collides with and sticks to a $4\text{ kg}$ cart with velocity $1\text{ m/s}$ (right is positive).

stimulus.description: Two carts before they stick together

items.stem: What is the velocity of the combined carts after the collision? Take right as positive.

options.why: Divides the first cart's momentum by the total mass only.
Divides total momentum by the first cart's mass.
Momentum is conserved, so $v=(2\cdot5+4\cdot(1))/6=2.33\text{ m/s}$.
Averages the two velocities without weighting by mass.
